# Paty Straffon Wellness

> Menopause coaching, strength training and nutrition for women in midlife. Paty Straffon is a GGS Certified Menopause Coaching Specialist, IIN Certified Health Coach and NASM Certified Personal Trainer, a former professional dancer and the creator of THRIVE. She is based in Vancouver, British Columbia, and coaches women online through her app.

Her approach is calm and science-informed, built on three pillars (Mind, Metabolism, Movement) and five levers that matter most in peri and post menopause: sleep, protein, strategic carbs, exercise, and fueling and recovery. No fear-based urgency and no restrictive dieting.

## Programs

- [The M Program](https://patystraffon.com/m-program): an 8-week coached program for perimenopause and beyond, delivered in the Paty Straffon Wellness app with a small group of women. Guided 25 to 35 minute strength and impact workouts, high-protein recipes and weekly check-ins, in three phases: Foundation, Build, Thrive. Next group: January 25 to March 19, 2027. Join the waitlist on the page for price details.
- [Free 5 Levers course](https://patystraffon.com/#guide): a free mini course of about four minutes per lesson, one lesson per lever, with personal results at the end.
- [THRIVE](https://patystraffon.com/thrive): a 55-minute, music-driven somatic cardio class for women that blends dance-inspired cardio, functional strength and breathwork. All levels. It runs live at events and retreats, and Paty mentors instructors who want to teach it.
- [Retreats](https://patystraffon.com/retreats): day and two-day retreats around Vancouver with THRIVE, breathwork and nourishing food, for small groups of women in midlife. Next dates: January 23, February 13, and April 23 to 24, 2027.

## Articles

- [Why am I gaining weight in perimenopause?](https://patystraffon.com/journal/perimenopause-weight-gain): what changes in the body, why eating less and training more backfires, and what helps instead.
- [The Journal](https://patystraffon.com/journal): all articles on perimenopause and menopause, weight, protein, strength, sleep and the nervous system.
- [Substack](https://patystraffonwellness.substack.com/): Paty's newsletter, with more articles.

## Books and shop

- [Protein, Beautifully](https://patystraffon.com/shop): an ebook of 52 high-protein recipes with meal plans for women in peri and post menopause.
- [Shop](https://patystraffon.com/shop): the equipment and supplements Paty recommends. The M Program book is coming in fall 2027.
